name: Collar
long_description:
Collar is helping enterprises fundraise faster.

Traction: 
$1.4M deals pending compliance in 2 months, half is Fortune 1000.
30 partners including Fortune 500, NYSE and NASDAQ-listed companies.
67% week over week growth in enterprise bookings.

Our proprietary agentic AI harness performs two-thirds of an investor relations team’s work, solving a $16B global market.

Founders: Kazel and Jamie are both repeat founders with buy-side finance experience. 
Kazel invented a new method of hacking with Softbank research funding at 17 before being recruited into Singapore’s Intelligence Service. 
Jamie was Chief of Staff at Openspace, a billion-dollar multi-asset manager.

They previously worked together as the youngest Singapore defence contractors.

Co-Founder & CEO at Collar (F26)
Repeat Founder, Ex-Finance, Ex-Intelligence.

Started hacking at 13, recruited by the Intelligence Service.
Built a deep tech startup at 16 as the youngest researcher under the National Graduate Research Innovation Program.

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio:
COO/Co-founder at Collar (YC F26), building AI for public company investor relations. Previously Chief of Staff at one of Southeast Asia's largest billion-dollar asset managers. Before that, COO of Singapore’s largest youth-in-tech organisation leading a team of 80 people. Fellow at the U.S. Department of State, and the youngest contractor for the Singapore military. Ex-HS valedictorian. Started first company at 18. 

From the little red dot (Singapore), a decent golfer, and a wannabe chef.

launches.title: Collar: the AI-native investor relations
launches.tagline: Collar delivers two-thirds of investor relations work in public companies.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re [Kazel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kazel-koh-en-yang-811172186/) and [Jamie](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jamiey3u/), co-founders of Collar.

**Collar is YC’s first Investor Relations startup.** 

In two months, we have **$1.4M** deals pending compliance, **$3.6M** meetings booked in the pipeline, and **67%** week on week growth in client engagements.

# **TL;DR**

Collar is AI-native investor relations, delivering two-thirds of investor relations work in public companies. We are solving a **$16B global market.**

**The Problem**

Investor relations teams have been doing the same admin work the same way for the last century.

Massive enterprises are still using legacy tools that are just chat interfaces layered on top of data feeds or ad-hoc unreliable DIY tools they built internally.

Leaving the entire industry still stuck in the pre-AI era.

**Our Solution**

Collar solves two-thirds of investor relations work so teams don’t have to spend $15K/month on consultants.

**Investor Q&A:** Prepare answers for all types of investor meetings: earnings calls, conferences, roadshows, and callbacks. Co-work on Collar with every company department, and link each answer to its source.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117940&key=user_uploads/1147891/cb209265-8925-4710-99a3-4628bfe489d6)

**Self-updating CRM:** Turn meeting notes and transcripts into investor records automatically. Keep proprietary company data, relationship history, commitments, and next steps in one place.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117940&key=user_uploads/1147891/96ab97f8-e9be-4d0e-b4b8-0d2250f6f424)

**Collar Live:** Get real-time talking points during earnings calls and investor meetings, with citation-backed context at your fingertips.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117940&key=user_uploads/1147891/8757321f-8aa0-46c9-b883-0b6662c173ca)

**The Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117940&key=user_uploads/1147891/c23546c0-9abb-4513-b018-56aaf11e1402)

Kazel and Jamie have known each other for over 5 years and they previously worked together as the youngest Singapore defence contractors.  

**Kazel (CEO)** 

* Invented a new method of hacking with Softbank research funding 
* Recruited into Singapore's Intelligence Service.
* Built a deep tech startup at 16 as the youngest researcher under the National Graduate Research Innovation Program.
* Worked on multi-million private credit deals across Asia at 18
* Studied at Cognitive Science in University of Michigan and LSE.

**Jamie (COO)** 

* Ex-Chief of Staff at a billion-dollar multi-asset manager. 
* Ex-COO of Singapore’s largest youth-in-tech organisation leading a team of 80 people. 
* Fellow at the U.S. Department of State
* Youngest contractor for the Singapore military. 
* Ex-HS valedictorian. 
* Started first company at 18.
